case_title: State of West Bengal v. Indrajit Kundu & Ors.
evidence_type: suicide letters, statements recorded during investigation
neutral_facts: The accused, who was an English teacher, had an intimate relationship with the victim, a painter and artist. The victim went to the accused's house to finalize a marriage proposal. The accused's parents, who were present, addressed the victim as a call-girl, which upset her. The victim committed suicide the following day. The prosecution relied on suicide notes and statements from the investigation to charge the accused under Section 306/34 IPC. The trial court framed charges, but the High Court discharged the accused, finding that the actions of the accused did not amount to abetment of suicide.
